prompts.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: isolated transparent F1 car sprite for a portfolio.
Create one extremely photorealistic modern Formula One racing car for Ferrari, in its recognizable team livery: glossy Ferrari racing red, white cockpit and engine-cover accents, black carbon wings, prancing horse shield, HP roundel, Shell on nose.
Exact DIRECTLY OVERHEAD ORTHOGRAPHIC view. Long axis perfectly horizontal, FRONT NOSE POINTING LEFT, rear wing RIGHT. Entire car visible, all four tires, centered with small even transparent margins, wide landscape canvas approximately 2.7:1.
Realistic sculpted ground-effect body, fine carbon-fiber weave, intricate multi-element front and rear wings, exposed suspension wishbones, cockpit halo with tiny helmet, slick black tires with yellow Pirelli markings, realistic sponsor decal placement. Premium automotive studio product photography, soft highlights reveal body shapes, crisp materials, physically credible anatomy. Similar scale and framing to an overhead automotive catalogue.
Genuinely transparent background, no floor or cast shadow outside car, no scene, no border, no captions, no speed trails. No perspective angle, no cartoon or vector style. Team-inspired render, prioritize recognizable livery and realistic materials.
